data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Vietnam Consumer Price Index (CPI): Foods and Foodstuffs data was reported at 244.770 2000=100 in Oct 2009. This records an increase from the previous number of 243.990 2000=100 for Sep 2009. Vietnam Consumer Price Index (CPI): Foods and Foodstuffs data is updated monthly, averaging 137.100 2000=100 from Jul 2001 (Median) to Oct 2009, with 99 observations. The data reached an all-time high of 244.770 2000=100 in Oct 2009 and a record low of 98.500 2000=100 in Jul 2001.
